profiles.Summary: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor is a demanding Unreal Engine 5 action-adventure that sits well above the Steam Deck's GPU class even at minimum PC specs, requiring aggressive settings reductions and FSR upscaling to achieve a stable 30 fps. The game is rated Playable on Deck and runs via Proton with gold-tier community reports, though performance can be inconsistent in open areas and during heavy combat.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1070 minimum, well above the Deck's ~GTX 1050 Ti class GPU) and general UE5 EA title behaviour on Deck. On your first run, check frame pacing in the opening outdoor area and inside the Mantis — if you see sustained drops below 25 fps even on these settings, lower shadow and view distance further or reduce the render resolution to 800x500.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render internally at 960x600 and rely on Deck FSR to upscale to 1280x800; TDP cap of 8 W keeps temperatures and fan noise low. Expect occasional dips below 30 fps in the most demanding outdoor zones.

KnownIssues: Performance can drop significantly in large open areas and dense combat encounters, making a stable 30 fps difficult to guarantee everywhere.
The game requires an internet connection on first launch for mandatory patching, which may be problematic in offline scenarios.
Shader compilation stutters are common on first play-through of new areas due to Unreal Engine 5's pipeline caching.
Some players report occasional crashes or hangs under Proton; GE-Proton has been noted to improve stability in similar UE5 EA titles.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Setting the refresh rate to 40 Hz and capping at 40 fps provides noticeably smoother motion than 30 fps; full 15 W TDP gives the APU maximum headroom but battery life is short. Be prepared to drop back to the Optimal profile in the most demanding zones.

Optimal.Notes: A locked 30 fps with a slightly higher render resolution and medium textures offers a reasonable visual experience for this demanding title. GE-Proton is recommended based on ProtonDB gold-tier reports for smoother compatibility.
